examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}から{学|まな}ぶ。
{失敗|しっぱい}から{学|まな}んだ。

notes:
{学|まな}ぶ is a godan verb meaning to study or learn, often implying deeper or academic learning.

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR VERBS:
- {学|まな}ぶ: to study/learn (formal, deep understanding)
- {習|なら}う: to learn (from a teacher, practical skills)
- {覚|おぼ}える: to memorize, remember
- {勉強|べんきょう}する: to study (general term)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜から{学|まな}ぶ: to learn from ~
- {経験|けいけん}から{学|まな}ぶ: to learn from experience
- {歴史|れきし}から{学|まな}ぶ: to learn from history
- {失敗|しっぱい}に{学|まな}ぶ: to learn from failure

RELATED WORDS:
- {学校|がっこう}: school
- {学生|がくせい}: student
- {学問|がくもん}: learning, scholarship
- {学者|がくしゃ}: scholar
